name: proxmox
description: Proxmox VE view (read-only: node status, VMs, inventory, tasks, task logs, backups, storage, backup coverage, firewall) plus guarded writes: create a Home Assistant OS or Ubuntu VM, and lock one VM behind the Proxmox firewall (inbound DROP). Plan by default, --apply --yes to write.

cli.help: maw proxmox [status|vms|vm <vmid>|inventory|tasks [--failed] [--limit N]|task-log <upid>|backups|ours|storage|firewall [<vmid>]|firewall lock|unlock <vmid> --name NAME [--apply --yes]|create haos|ubuntu --vmid N --name NAME --ip A.B.C.D/24 [--apply --yes]] [--json] [--insecure] [--debug]
